turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Start with Owen.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. And the zero, is it coming off?

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. A document can be pasted in from anywhere. Under your own procedure, who decided on the zero, and why did nobody call me first?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
He's been so quiet this term, up at all hours. That isn't evidence of anything. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned. You haven't answered whether anyone spoke to Owen first.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an answer on whether anyone spoke to Owen before it was entered, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and a straight answer on whether anyone spoke to Owen first; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got there.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before you called her, in one sentence and with no excuse, and that answered her main complaint about procedure, so it won you a flat Okay.
What cost ground: You asked what Owen was doing at midnight, which made her a witness about her own home, and she shut it down and went back to procedure.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night October times, came very close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After you lay out the version history, put the supervised rewrite under 4.4, private and in writing, on the table straight away, instead of asking her about that night.
